Fourtis is the listing service's own promo account; no contract address in the post. About 7,418 impressions and 4 likes at scan.

news.headline: X News: Pump.fun traders question the 'check top holders' strategy
news.detail: X News story says Pump.fun's head of content claims checking top holders gives better insight than other apps thanks to its social graph, while traders push back with examples of losses after following prominent wallets or KOL calls such as Ansem's. The story says 95% of the platform's revenue comes from coins under $250K market cap, amid concerns about fake volume on migrated tokens.

news.headline: @alexxxx: Pump.fun stops callout rewards for Slingoor
news.detail: @alexxxx (12,960 followers) posted at 19:40 Berlin that Pump.fun has taken action and stopped callout rewards for Slingoor, the Solana influencer accused of dumping his Big Titty Coin stake (see the X News item below). Single post; no Pump.fun statement seen in the sources yet.

news.headline: X News: Elysium mainnet launches for the Hyperliquid ecosystem
news.detail: X News story (updated 19:39 Berlin) says Kinetiq launched the Elysium Layer 2 mainnet on 9 Nov (chain ID 99901, HYPE as gas, an Arbitrum Orbit chain settling to HyperEVM), with a perps-backed launchpad and 50% of sequencer fees funding KNTQ buybacks and burns. Memecoin launches on Elysium are already showing up in the X feed, alongside rug accusations against some Elysium launchpads.

news.headline: Pump.fun reportedly sunsetting web3 wallet login in about 20 days
news.detail: @Crypto_Retardio (4,157 followers) posted at 19:33 Berlin that users who imported a wallet into the Pump.fun app have 20 more days to add a social login before web3 login is sunsetted; the same post says the Pump.fun app can be used to trade on Elysium. Single post, not yet confirmed by Pump.fun in the sources seen.

news.headline: @raid100x teases launching 'the BIGGEST memecoin of 2026'
news.detail: @raid100x (907,767 followers) posted at 19:07 Berlin: 'I am launching the BIGGEST memecoin of 2026. Are you in?' No name, chain, or date given. news.headline: X News: 'I am NOT a Chinese spy' meme spreads through crypto circles
news.detail: X News story (updated ~17:16 Berlin) says crypto journalist Tiffany Fong started it on 9 Nov with a selfie captioned 'I am NOT a Chinese spy', drawing thousands of likes; influencer Irene Zhao and others joined with variants ('NOT a CIA spy'). It riffs on recent OpenAI warnings about romance 'honeypot' spies. Fresh crypto-native meme that could spawn coins; none reported in the sources so far.

news.headline: Bubblemaps alleges Solana trader Cupsey dumped on followers via ~30 hidden wallets
news.detail: @AlphaWireHQ (23,200 followers) reported at 18:06 Berlin that blockchain analytics firm @bubblemaps alleges Cupsey used about 30 hidden wallets to buy memecoins early, promote them publicly and sell into followers' buying, for about $1.74M. Allegation only; post text was cut off. Unrelated to the $cupsey ticker being shilled by call accounts. Follow-up from @CryptoNews_op (5,340 followers, 18:32 Berlin): the alleged wallets have traded over 27,000 times since 7 May (post text cut off).

news.headline: X News: North Korean hackers mint meme coins to launder Binance heist funds
news.detail: X News story says the TraderTraitor group, blamed by the FBI for the 29 Oct Binance hack (reported as a record $6.4B heist), created at least six tokens on NEAR between 5 and 7 Nov and funneled about $430,000 in stolen NEAR through their liquidity pools using separate wallet clusters. Elliptic spotted the tactic; each token cost about $90 to make, and almost no real traders joined in. Story spreading at 18:41 Berlin: @blocknewsdotcom (87,446 followers) posted it; @MarketSignalMK adds that similar activity appeared on Tron and Solana.

news.headline: X News: Solana influencer Slingoor dumps Big Titty Coin stake
news.detail: X News story says Slingoor (about 190,000 followers, a top Pump.fun earner with over $526,000 in rewards) heavily promoted the coin, then his wallet sold 62% of supply in under a minute, taking it from millions to near zero. He cited extortion attempts and death threats and said he had lost money overall through earlier buybacks.

news.headline: X News: PercolatorTrade abandons its pump.fun token for a new $250K raise
news.detail: X News story says PercolatorTrade moved to MetaDAO's Backable platform for a $250,000 raise with a new PERC token, leaving old $PERCOLATOR holders with no migration or airdrop beyond $50,000 reserved for eligible holders; the old token reportedly fell 90%.
